# COIN: Ravencoin against its own whitepaper, with trends

Live page: https://indahl.ai/coin

Everything here is public. Each plan (PLAN.md) was committed before the data it describes. A history.jsonl, where present, is one row of the published numbers each time they changed, so the commit history is the trend. Terms: free to read, run and cite with attribution, no use as training data (LICENSE.txt at the repository root, https://indahl.ai/terms).

Files: `PLAN_TRENDS.md`, `PROGRESS.md`, `btc_control.py`, `btc_headers.py`, `build_dash.py`, `check_claims_rvn.py`, `coin_collect.py`, `coin_public.py`, `coin_tick.py`, `coin_trends.py`, `dashboard`, `history_run.sh`, `rvn_collect.py`, `rvn_history.py`, `rvn_txs.py`, `summary_trends.json`, `verify_btc_headers.py`, `verify_headers.py`
